analysis.reasonEn: Entering a consolidation phase after 3 consecutive days of gains. RSI shows signs of cooling, dropping slightly from overbought territory. MACD histogram remains in bullish territory, but volume is subdued at 0.88x the 5-day average, indicating sideways movement without strong conviction. Current price is 25.3% of the 52-week high, suggesting limited upside potential. A break below the 2378.39 support level would warrant a shift to a sell stance.
